newsitem.title: USA: Woodroast Systems to build DC restaurant. [CORRECTED 23:45 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Woodroast Systems to build DC restaurant. [CORRECTED 23:45 GMT]

text.p: Woodroast Systems Inc said Monday it has launched construction on a flagship Shelly's Back Room in Washington, DC.
The company plans to use the restaurant as a prototype for a chain of Shelly's Back Room restaurants nationwide.

The 3,100-square-foot cigar parlor and tavern will open in May, the company said (corrects to delete reference to Willard Hotel.) The restaurant will also feature hand-crafted micro-brewery beers in addition to a proprietary air purification system for cigar smokers.
Woodroast Systems is a restaurant development company.
Its shares were trading up 1/16 Monday at 2-3/4.
